payload.text: Put to hv, with the facts in close-state.md at refs/bank/vc/st1c2db93/close-notes: the install pointer ~/.local/share/intent/home names Intent's dev checkout, so every estate's pre-commit gate on rhadamanth runs lib/templates/hooks/pre-commit.sh from Intent's main while intent is brew 3.5.3. Only intent bootstrap writes the pointer. Options: intent use brew|opt|dev publishes it for the tree it selects, or intent bootstrap from brew by hand.
